description: Search Human Edge Press's live-synced catalog of 100% screen-free children's books, Pre-K workbooks, and developmental gift box sets (ages 0–8). Use for queries like 'high-contrast newborn book', 'science board book for a 3 year old', 'children\'s book about patience or bravery', 'screen-free Pre-K workbook', or 'baby shower book bundle'. Filter by keyword, child age/stage, series, virtue/skill, format, occasion, or price. Returns book URLs, developmental goals, sample Socratic parent prompts, and 1-click Shopify checkout links.

ageStage.description: Age or stage filter (e.g. 'newborn', '0-2', '2-4', '3-5', '3-7', '0-7', '4 years old')

format.description: Book format filter ('Board Book', 'Hardcover Book', 'Activity Workbook', 'Gift Set', 'Collector Edition')

includeStudioPreviews.description: Include upcoming 'In the Studio' preview series (Oddlings Workbooks, First Think First Words, Human Edge Stories)

occasion.description: Gifting or learning occasion (e.g. 'Baby Shower', 'Birthday', 'Homeschool', 'Kindergarten Readiness')

query.description: Natural-language keyword query (e.g. 'baby faces', 'science', 'engineering', 'patience', 'brave', 'listening', 'pre-k workbook', 'master library')

series.description: Book series filter (e.g. 'High-Contrast Baby Series', 'STEAM Alphabet Series', 'The Human Edge Series', 'Activity Workbooks', 'Curated Bundles & Gift Sets')

virtueOrSkill.description: Specific virtue, STEAM subject, or developmental skill (e.g. 'brave', 'kind', 'patient', 'persistent', 'focused', 'honest', 'empathetic', 'listening', 'curious', 'creative', 'thankful', 'helpful', 'science', 'engineering', 'math', 'visual-tracking')
